lines.t:
The "class" of a <c:ffff00>{{medal}}<c>, which changes in 3 stages
according to its <c:ffff00>{{medal_level}}<c>.
It determines how many <c:ffff00>Medalia slots<c> and
<c:ffff00>{{medaforce|pl}}<c> can be used, and how much the <c:ffff00>{{stats}}<c> of
the <c:ffff00>{{best_skill}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{best_legs}}<c> rise:
  {{bronze}} (level 0-32): 1 slot, 1 {{medaforce}}, +2
  {{silver}} (33-65): 2 slots, 2 {{medaforce|pl}}, +4
  {{gold}} (66-150): 3 slots, 3 {{medaforce|pl}}, +6
